We have the mapped_rxn string. The task: "return all possible precursors of applying the template as the result of the task make_1_lvl1-template_search-1 to the molecule below". The molecule is given as initial_molecule with atom mapping. The template's mapped_rxn shows a reaction: reactants -> product. The product side appears to be the target molecule (with stereochemistry). The reactant side is the precursor(s). The mapped_rxn shows a single reactant? Actually it's "([CH3:1]/[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)=[CH:9]/[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C:13](=[O:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18])>>(...)" So left side is one molecule (maybe a vinyl trifluoroacetyl? Actually it's a chain). So the precursor is that SMILES (without mapping). Need to return list of lists of SMILES strings for each possible combination. Here only one precursor combination: a single precursor SMILES. So output: [["[CH3]/C([c]1[cH][cH][cH][cH][cH]1)=[CH]/CH2CH2CH2C(=O)C(F)(F)F"]]? Need to convert mapped SMILES to normal SMILES (remove atom map numbers and stereochemistry maybe). The mapped_rxn left side: "([CH3:1]/[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)=[CH:9]/[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C:13](=[O:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18])". Remove parentheses outer. So precursor SMILES: "[CH3]/C([c]1[cH][cH][cH][cH][cH]1)=[CH]/CH2CH2CH2C(=O)C(F)(F)F". Need to ensure correct SMILES: CH3 attached to C which is attached to aromatic ring? Actually [C:2]([c:3]1... ) is a carbon attached to aromatic carbon? The SMILES: [CH3:1]/[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)=[CH:9]/[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C:13](=[O:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]

Simplify: CH3- C(=CH-CH2-CH2-CH2-C(=O)-C(F)(F)F) with aromatic substituent on that C. The C attached to aromatic ring is sp2? Actually C2 is double bonded to CH9. C2 also attached to aromatic carbon c3 (aryl). So it's a styryl type.

Thus SMILES: "C/C(=C/CH2CH2CH2C(=O)C(F)(F)F)(c1ccccc1)"? Need to include aromatic ring: c1ccccc1. So final: "C/C(=C/CH2CH2CH2C(=O)C(F)(F)F)c1ccccc1". Use slash for E geometry. That's fine.

Return list of list: [["C/C(=C/CH2CH2CH2C(=O)C(F)(F)F)c1ccccc1"]].

Check if any other possible precursors? Template may generate two fragments? But only one reactant. So answer.
